title: Chapter 302 - 302 Discussion On Team-Building; Begin!

Chapter 302 - 302 Discussion On Team-Building; Begin!

Chapter 302 - 302 Discussion on Team-Building; Begin!

302 Discussion on Team-Building; Begin!

Qin Yuxuan looked at the caller ID. It was Senior Lu.

Therefore, she answered the call without any hesitation.

“Yuxuan, are you with Lin Fan?” Senior Lu asked.

“Yes, what’s the matter, Senior Lu?” Qin Yuxuan asked.

“Oh, didn’t we receive a lot of big orders recently? Yesterday, everyone worked overtime and we’ve basically finished dealing with the matters in the early stages.

“There will be a lot of things to do later… Therefore, I was thinking that I should organize a team-building event in the next one or two days so that everyone can have fun and relax… What do you think?”

Qin Yuxuan was a person who was motivated and had great management talent.

She knew very well that she had to be lax in the management of the employees.

Otherwise, there would be problems.

Ever since the company was established, there had never been any team-building activities.

Besides, just like Senior Lu said, the entire company would be very busy soon.

Before that, the team-building event could allow the employees to relax. At the same time, it could also cultivate a tacit understanding between the employees and increase their work efficiency in the future. This was a good thing.

“I think it’s a good idea.” Qin Yuxuan replied.

Senior Lu said happily, “I knew that you’d agree!

“Alright, you two can continue being sweet. I won’t disturb you anymore.”

After saying that, she hung up the phone.

Lin Fan heard the conversation.

“If it’s a team-building event, I have a good place in mind… How about I help arrange it?” Lin Fan said.

Qin Yuxuan had absolute trust in Lin Fan. Without any hesitation, she nodded and said, “Alright!”

At this moment, Lin Fan’s phone rang.

However, it was an unknown number.

“Hello, is this Mr. Lin Fan?” A slightly respectful voice came from the phone.

Lin Fan said, “It’s me. And you are?”

“The Solange luxury yacht you ordered has arrived at the port of Modu. You can go and check it at any time… Also, do you have any other questions or need any help?”

Wan Bo had a certain status in the company.

However, he knew very well that he was nothing in front of a person who had ordered Solange.

Therefore, his tone was extremely respectful.

Lin Fan’s face revealed an expression that seemed to say, ‘I knew it’. He said, “Alright… I might need to use it to go out to sea and hold a party in the next two days. Can you help me find some crew members and waiters?”

“Of course. If you need anything, you can call me anytime,” Wan Bo said.

After Lin Fan hung up, he said to Qin Yuxuan, “I’ve already made the arrangements. Now it’s up to you when you want to hold it.”

“I’ll ask Senior Lu and the others.”

Lin Fan and Qin Yuxuan did not go out for the entire day.

The two of them were like a young couple on vacation. They ate together, watched TV together, and…

It was very relaxing and warm.

…

In the blink of an eye, it was the second day.

When the morning sun rose, Qin Yuxuan drove the Mini Cooper and brought Lin Fan to the Global Financial Tower.

At this moment, all the employees of Fan Yu Investment were waiting downstairs with their backpacks, sunglasses, and hats on their faces.

That was because today was the day of Fan Yu Investment’s team-building event!

When they saw Qin Yuxuan and Lin Fan getting out of the Mini Cooper, they shouted, “Hello, Mr. Lin. Hello, President Qin!”

Evidently, everyone had some understanding of Lin Fan’s identity.

“Today is the day of our Fan Yu Investment’s team-building event,” Qin Yuxuan cleared her throat and said. “There’s no boss or leader today. Everyone is friends. Later, we’ll have a good meal and have fun together!”

“Alright!” Everyone shouted in unison.

At this moment, a Mercedes-Benz luxury bus drove over from afar and stopped in front of everyone.

“The bus has arrived. Let’s set off!” Qin Yuxuan said.”

The Global Financial Tower was not far from the dock. In just half an hour, everyone could already see the blue sea.

After getting out of the bus, everyone welcomed the sea breeze, their faces filled with satisfaction.

At this moment, a man in a suit walked over from afar and said respectfully to Lin Fan, “Mr. Lin, this way please.”

He… was Wan Bo, the manager of the company who called Lin Fan yesterday.

Lin Fan nodded his head and walked forward.

This was a dock, and there were many boats and yachts docked by the river bank.

Everyone walked and watched, occasionally letting out a burst of discussion.

“That ship is quite beautiful.”

“There are actually so many ships docked here…”

“Modu’s housing prices are so expensive. What do you think about buying a ship and using it as a house?”

“You have to be really rich. That’s because they had to pay at least a six-figure management fee to dock here for a year.”

“Hiss! I was too hasty.”

Someone suddenly shouted, “Wow! Look, that ship over there is so cool! It’s even cooler than the ships in movies!”

“It’s so cool! It would be great if we board it and take a look.”

“Board it? Don’t think about it.”

“This is Solange, a luxury yacht!”

“That’s right! It’s Solange! I saw this yacht in a magazine two days ago. The price is 1.2 billion yuan!”

“1.2 billion? Hiss!”

Lin Fan heard everything everyone said.

He smiled and touched his nose. “Since everyone likes this yacht so much, let’s get on it.”

Many of the employees looked puzzled.

Lin Fan smiled. “We’re going to have our team-building event on this yacht today.”

Silence!

The entire scene was silent!

Everyone’s faces were filled with horror.

One had to know…

They had just heard that this yacht was called Solange! It was worth 1.2 billion!

Of course, even if they did not know all this, just the exterior of the yacht was enough to shock them.

Yesterday, everyone already knew that they were going to hold a team-building event at sea.

This made everyone extremely happy.

However, everyone thought that they were just going to rent a dilapidated boat or buy tickets to hop on board a large cruise…

However, it turned out to be a tall luxury yacht?

This… Were they dreaming?

Everyone was still in disbelief.

At that moment, the attendants on Solange seemed to be confirming Lin Fan’s words. They got off the yacht one after another, bowed, and said in an extremely respectful tone, “Welcome, everyone! I wish everyone a happy time!”
